_about: Known data-check errors caused by the filing itself, not by this code. Each entry: ticker -> check id -> reason. The data-checks test fails on any error not listed here, and on any entry that no longer occurs (so the list cannot rot). A reason starting with "Intermittent:" is exempt from the stale check, for filings that hover at a limit.

APA.missing-core: APA tags revenue only by product (oil, gas, NGL) with dimensions; the company-level revenue total is not in SEC company facts.

FOX.market-cap: Intermittent: Nasdaq's market caps for Fox's two share classes imply about 570M shares, against about 430M Class A and Class B shares combined in Fox's filings (diluted weighted shares). The gap sits near the 25% limit, so the error comes and goes with the price.

LHX.missing-core: L3Harris tagged full-year FY2025 revenue ($21.9B) with a start date of 2025-10-04, so it reads as a quarter.
